recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the only remaining misleading source defect found for FHIR-32673 while preserving the already-applied modifier definitions and avoiding a broader redesign of token text-search semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core R5 issue asking whether token `:text` should support word-boundary or prefix-style matching. The accepted resolution defined two modifiers: `:text-advanced`, equivalent to token `:text` but using advanced string processing, and `:code-text`, for partial text searching on the code/value portion of Coding or Identifier.
initial_application: No original historical commit explicitly tagged FHIR-32673 was found. The 2022 search modifier rewrite applied the requested modifiers: commit 6ce165cfe8e0ba45096d394c0a433af5bd8524cc added the detailed `text-advanced` search-page section, and commit 7c3f73fb1f51cbbb40b332c19799a40dbab2bfaf added `code-text` and `text-advanced` to the search-modifier-code CodeSystem. That path left one typo, `code:text-ad=headache`, in the `text-advanced` POST example.
additional_context: The linked Zulip threads show the rationale was word-based or advanced display-text matching for tokens without changing basic token `:text` semantics. FHIR-I minutes record a 12-0-0 persuasive vote. Later related reconciliations already on the combined branch fixed adjacent `:code-text` and `:text-advanced` wording for FHIR-40842 and FHIR-35812. FHIR-36651 is a separate Resolved - change required VCL/in-vcl issue and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html so the `text-advanced` POST example uses `code:text-advanced=headache`, matching the GET example and the accepted modifier name. No CodeSystem or value set source was changed because the active search-modifier-code source already contains both modifier codes.
source_changes: source/search.html: corrected the `text-advanced` POST example from `code:text-ad=headache` to `code:text-advanced=headache`.
